ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: on the left of the figure is a benzene ring, the benzene ring is connected through a nitrogen atom to the middle hydrazine fragment; in the middle, two connected nitrogens are visible, one bearing H, the other labeled as NH and connected to the right ring. On the right is a six-membered non-aromatic ring, with one C=C double bond in the ring, and one alkene carbon is connected to an -NH-NH-phenyl substituent. The figure also has curved arrows, but the problem requires ignoring these arrows. Reasoning: after ignoring the arrows, treat the right ring as a cyclohexene skeleton bearing one double bond, and starting from the substituent-bearing alkene carbon write as C1=C(...)CCCC1. The branch on this alkene carbon is N-N-phenyl, namely NNc2ccccc2. Therefore combining gives the SMILES: C1=C(NNc2ccccc2)CCCC1.

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: First describe the visual molecule as an atom graph rather than a reaction: ignore all curved arrows, record the six-membered nonaromatic ring on the right with one C=C bond, and note that one alkene carbon carries an -NH-NH-phenyl substituent. Then write the right ring in SMILES starting at the substituted alkene carbon: C1=C(...)CCCC1. Fill the branch with the hydrazine-phenyl group, using N bonded to N bonded to aromatic phenyl, NNc2ccccc2. Combine these to obtain C1=C(NNc2ccccc2)CCCC1.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中左侧是一个苯环，苯环通过一个氮原子连接到中间的肼基片段；中间可见两个相连的氮，其中一个带 H，另一个标为 NH 并连接到右侧环。右侧是一个六元非芳香环，环内有一个 C=C 双键，其中一个烯烃碳连接到 -NH-NH-苯基取代基。图中还有弯曲箭头，但题目要求忽略这些箭头。推理：忽略箭头后，把右侧环看作带一个双键的环己烯骨架，并从带取代基的烯烃碳开始写作 C1=C(...)CCCC1。该烯烃碳上的支链是 N-N-苯基，即 NNc2ccccc2。因此组合得到 SMILES：C1=C(NNc2ccccc2)CCCC1。
